answer: Let independent underwriters post a bond behind each identity and charge a premium for the risk: proven fraud pays claims straight out of that vault, so an underwriter who backs fakes loses real money. A sybil farmer must buy coverage for every clone, and no honest underwriter offers a haven to a thousand identical strangers — premiums explode with each suspicious twin, like water vanishing into karst instead of pooling. Underwriters compete on audit quality, so the market prices fakes out before they earn. Limit: a rich farmer can self-insure, so underwriters must stay independent and capped.
